abilities.name: Opportunist
abilities.description: When any Digimon within 3 spaces of your partner Digimon rolls a natural 1 and misses with an attack, your Digimon may use their Free Action to make an attack against that Digimon.

abilities.name: Wider Reach
abilities.description: Opportunist's range increases from 3 spaces to 6 spaces.

abilities.name: Exploit Weakness
abilities.description: Opportunist now triggers on a natural roll of 1 through 5, not just a natural 1.

abilities.name: Control Freak
abilities.description: Once per encounter, choose a target. Make a Roar check. The target makes a Core Drive check to resist. If your result is higher, they skip their next turn.

abilities.name: No Limits
abilities.description: Opportunist no longer uses your Free Action, and it can trigger on every miss within range, not just once.

abilities.name: Digimon Emperor
abilities.description: Once between rests, at the start of your turn, you may activate Digimon Emperor. Until the end of the encounter, all enemies within 6 spaces take -3 to hit and damage. All allies within 6 spaces gain +3 to hit and damage.
